definitions.ask: Should a bare `@route` or `@route#section` also make a spaced `.` prefer `&`, not just `@route:id`/`^id`/`+id`?
definitions.why: After any route, a second `@` turns the first into prose or raises duplicate_capture_marker

choices.label: `Buy milk @foo .` gives `&` too; a trailing prose `@name .` also gives `&`
Only block-ID markers count; `Buy milk @foo .` keeps `@`, which turns `@foo` into prose

definitions.ask: Should the glossary capture-alias strand be updated for the new spaced `.` precedence?
definitions.corrects: `*` opens the Depends On / Blocks picker and no `^`, `@`, or `:` alias applies
